body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2006 CES') -- <Visual News>

Symbol has unveiled its new mobile computer MC70 with a scanner built inside at CES 2006. This is the next generation EDA(Enterprise Digital Assistant) that features durability(rugged construction), Bluetooth function, and scanning capability. So, it enables managers, executives, doctors, or salespeople to have immediate access to the most current enterprise information using both voice and data communication in the field.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2006 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Yoojin Kim / IKKim, Alliyah Seo correspondents of AVING to CES / edited by Daniel Sirh>
